name: Rogue
source: Pathfinder GM Core, "Building Creatures", Class Road Maps, via Archives of Nethys: https://2e.aonprd.com/Rules.aspx?ID=2874
license: ORC License: Paizo's Pathfinder GM Core is ORC licensed material.
rules: High Perception; high Stealth and Thievery, plus more skills than usual; high Dex (or key attribute for a specific rogue's racket); high AC; low Fortitude, high Reflex; low to moderate HP; moderate attack and low to moderate damage before sneak attack plus high or extreme damage with sneak attack. Abilities: Sneak attack, surprise attack, deny advantage, debilitating strike, master strike, rogue's racket and related feats

notes.skills: High Stealth and Thievery, and more skills than usual.
notes.attributes: High Dexterity (or the key attribute of the rogue's racket).
notes.defense: High AC; low Fortitude, high Reflex; low to moderate HP.
notes.offense: Moderate attack bonus and low to moderate damage before sneak attack, high or extreme damage with sneak attack.
notes.specials: Sneak attack, surprise attack, deny advantage, debilitating strike, master strike, rogue's racket and related feats.
